actual_scope: Independent source-bound application of Greer Guthrie PR679 support and volume obstruction to PR1779/1817 diagonal batches on the selected supplier; exact finite recipe and selector-repair checks.
scope_change_reason: The selected record is sound within its stated checks. Live PR1779 and PR1817 explicitly leave a changed child contract open; this audits that precise inherited RecipesExact boundary rather than repeating known owner/certificate audits. Final local overlap found the existing PR679 theorem; retain full credit and publish an independent corroboration/handoff, with no duplicate theorem PR.
bottleneck_link: The binding complex profile is dominated by small children. A rank-shape screen has meaning only when the priced child implements the direct-sum operation on independent dirty inputs.
stop_rule: Prove or falsify the one-child monomial-adapter implication, bind it to the eight original selected batches, produce exact witnesses and meaningful controls, then verify and hand off; no general synthesis or supplier adoption.
